text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: reserved-gpu-pool AsteriBank saturated, queue growth detected. paging oncall

Maria H: I'm on it, @devon-k @samir-r — seeing alert in console, queue size spiking for reserved-pool-a1.

Devon K: oncall here. what's the customer impact? any 5xxs?

Samir R: Customer traffic is being throttled, some requests queuing > 30s. No 5xx yet, but latency SLO for AsteriBank chat endpoints breached.

Helena P: AsteriBank has reservation id resv-ast-01 with 8 gpus. metric shows all 8 at 98-100% util, autoscaler attempted +2 but hit max_replicas limit.

Maria H: snapshot from metrics:
```
# queue and pool metrics (PromQL)
sum(rate(resv_pool_queue_length{reservation="resv-ast-01"}[30s])) by (pool)
max_over_time(gpu_utilization{pool="resv-ast-01"}[2m])
```

Devon K: autoscaler logs show: `scale rejected: max_replicas 10 reached` for pool resv-ast-01. Also seeing frequent pod preemptions from noisy-session-owner tenant 'test-lab-9'.

Samir R: noisy sessions are ephemeral but heavy. They're creating long-lived pinned sessions with batch jobs that keep KV cache warm. We should consider evicting long-idle sessions or throttling session creation for non-enterprise tenants.

Helena P: quick mitigation plan ideas: 1) temporarily increase max_replicas for resv-ast-01 (requires infra approval), 2) enable spillover routing to shared-tier (if allowed by tenant policy), 3) force-evict noisy sessions older than 15m, 4) notify CS + customer.

Maria H: I can run an emergency eviction script to drop sessions > 15m except those owned by AsteriBank. Will do unless objections.

Devon K: do it. add a safety flag to avoid killing pinned model-kv sessions for active requests. Also check that spillover won't violate data isolation (AsteriBank policy forbids shared fallback).

Samir R: confirmed: AsteriBank has strict no-shared-fallback. So spillover is not an option. We need to free reserved GPUs or increase capacity.

Ops Pager: @here manual capacity increase requires ops-approval and will take ~8-12m to provision new nodes. Are we ok with that window?

Helena P: yes we should request capacity increase AND run targeted evictions. Capacity increase as durable fix, evictions as immediate relief.

Maria H: running eviction now — command:
```
# evict sessions older than 15m except those with tag customer:AsteriBank
redwoodctl sessions list --pool resv-ast-01 --age >15m --format id,owner,age | grep -v "customer:AsteriBank" | xargs -r redwoodctl sessions evict --force
```

Devon K: watching logs. Maria, paste any errors.

Maria H: evictions in progress. 12 sessions terminated, 3 were flagged "pinned-active" and skipped. GPU util down to ~85% on some hosts. queue rate dropping from 120r/s to 40r/s.

Samir R: nice. however still seeing a few hosts at 99% because noisy tenant split across many nodes. I'd like to identify the culprit sessions:
```
redwoodctl sessions top --pool resv-ast-01 --sort gpu_time | head -n 20
```

Helena P: found 3 long-running sessions from tenant id test-lab-9, age ~3h, continuous generation. Marking them for escalation to tenant enforcement.

Devon K: escalate noisy tenant enforcement to infra policy: rate-limit session concurrency for non-reserved tenants on reserved pools. Ticketing after incident. For now, we can force-evict those 3.

Maria H: forcing those 3 evictions now.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: ACTION: 15 sessions evicted (including 3 noisy-lab). Pool utilization dropping.

Helena P: new metrics: gpu_util avg 62%, queue length down to 8, latency trending back under SLO but still a few stragglers.

Devon K: customer impact: AsteriBank team reported degraded response times for 12 minutes, no data leakage, no 5xx. CS notified and looped in account lead.

Maria H: I've requested a temporary capacity bump with ops: ticket OP-4931. Asked for +2 H100-equivalent nodes in us-east-1 as buffer. Ops acknowledged, ETA 11 minutes.

Ops Pager: ops accepted, provisioning started. ETA ~10m.

Samir R: recommend postmortem items: tighten autoscaler limits to allow emergency scale beyond max_replicas via controlled override, implement tenant-level session concurrency caps, and enforce soft quotas for long-running sessions in reserved pools.

Helena P: agree. Also add a runtime check that prevents non-reserved tenants from creating long-lived warm sessions on reserved pools.

Devon K: sending short customer-facing note to AsteriBank: "We detected elevated queueing on your reserved capacity causing slower responses. We executed prioritized evictions of noisy sessions and provisioned additional capacity; service restored. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline and preventative actions." (keeping it high-level).

Maria H: sending message now, CC'ing account lead.

IncidentBot: :information_source: NOTE: ops ticket OP-4931 created, infra change id infra-7392. Incident channel marked for follow-up.

Helena P: further diagnostics show autoscaler attempted to spin up smaller GPU instances but placement constraints (reservation affinity) prevented placement — something to address: allow mixed instance types as temporary emergency fallback.

Samir R: logging follow-up tasks: 1) PM + infra to evaluate mixed-type fallback, 2) quota override flow for oncall with audit trail, 3) tenant enforcement rule for session concurrency, 4) CS runbook update for communicating reserved-capacity events. I'll create tickets and link here.

Devon K: thanks team. I'm going to hand this to day shift for full RCA. Oncall closing our pager.

Maria H: leaving notes in incident board, tagging helena and samir for RCA.

Helena P: closing thread; last metrics look stable. Will open postmortem draft in 24h. :eyes:

Ops Pager: :lock: OP-4931 resolved (capacity placed), incident closed pending postmortem.
